g.text: FIGURE 1: DIFFERENTIAL EQUATIONS FOUNDATIONS, ORDER, DEGREE & LINEARITY ENGINE
Mathematical Classification, Dependent vs Independent Variables, Radical Clearing & Arbitrary Constants Elimination
GATE 2027 TITANS ENGINE
SPEC: ULTRA-HD 4K BLUEPRINT
1. ANATOMY & VARIABLE TOPOLOGY
VARIABLE ROLES: y = f(x)
• Dependent Variable (y): The unknown function undergoing differentiation.
• Independent Variable (x): The reference variable w.r.t. which changes occur.
• Inversion Trap: If dx/dy appears, x is dependent and y is independent!
ODE vs PDE TAXONOMY
ORDINARY DIFF. EQ (ODE)
• Single independent variable: y = f(x)
• Standard total derivatives: dy/dx, d²y/dx²
Ex: d²y/dx² + 5 dy/dx + 6y = 0
PARTIAL DIFF. EQ (PDE)
• Multiple independent variables: u(x, y, t)
• Partial derivatives: ∂u/∂x, ∂²u/∂t²
Ex: ∂²u/∂x² + ∂²u/∂y² = 0 (Laplace)
FORMATION OF ODE: ELIMINATING CONSTANTS
Number of Essential Arbitrary Constants (n) = Order of Resulting ODE (n).
Differentiate n times to yield (n + 1) equations; eliminate c₁, c₂, ..., cₙ via determinant or substitution.
Family: y = A e^(2x) + B e^(-2x) (2 constants) ⟹ y' = 2A e^(2x) - 2B e^(-2x)
⟹ y'' = 4(A e^(2x) + B e^(-2x)) = 4y ⟹ y'' - 4y = 0 (Order 2, Degree 1)
2. ORDER & DEGREE DECISION MATRIX
CANONICAL DEFINITIONS
• ORDER: The order of the highest derivative present in the differential equation.
• DEGREE: The power of the highest order derivative after the equation is made a
polynomial in all its derivatives (free from radicals and fractions w.r.t. derivatives).
⚠️ CRITICAL: Non-polynomial in derivatives ⟹ DEGREE IS NOT DEFINED!
DEGREE DETERMINATION WORKFLOW & TRAP FILTER
STEP 1: LOCATE HIGHEST DERIVATIVE
Identify max derivative order (n).
Order = n (Always defined!)
STEP 2: CHECK TRANSCENDENTALS
Are derivatives inside sin, cos, e, ln?
Can they be freed algebraically?
STEP 3: CLEAR RADICALS
Raise both sides to integer power.
Inspect exponent of y^(n).
EXAM DRILL BENCHMARK EQUATIONS
Equation: [1 + (dy/dx)²]^(3/2) = c (d²y/dx²)
Square both sides: [1 + (y')²]³ = c² (y'')² ⟹ Order = 2, Degree = 2
Equation: d²y/dx² + sin(dy/dx) = 0
sin(y') = y' - (y')³/6 + ... cannot be cleared ⟹ Order = 2, Degree = NOT DEFINED
Equation: dy/dx = cos(x + y)
Dependent y is inside cos, but derivatives are polynomials ⟹ Order = 1, Degree = 1
3. LINEAR VS NON-LINEAR TAXONOMY
THE 3 STRICT AXIOMS OF A LINEAR ODE
A differential equation is LINEAR if and only if ALL THREE conditions hold simultaneously:
1. Every dependent variable y and all its derivatives have power strictly equal to 1.
2. No product of dependent variable and its derivative (y · y') or derivatives (y' · y'').
3. No non-linear functions of dependent variable (sin y, e^y, ln y, 1/y) are present.
QUICK-DECISION LINEARITY DIAGNOSTIC
d²y/dx² + x² dy/dx + (sin x) y = e^x
✓ LINEAR
y (dy/dx) + x = 0
✗ NON-LINEAR (y · y' term)
d²y/dx² + y² = 0
✗ NON-LINEAR (power of y = 2)
dy/dx + sin y = 0
✗ NON-LINEAR (transcendental sin y)
4. ESSENTIAL ARBITRARY CONSTANTS & EXAM TRAP ARSENAL
A. ESSENTIAL VS ARTIFICIAL CONSTANTS
Number of arbitrary constants in general solution = Order of ODE.
Constants must be ESSENTIAL (cannot be algebraically combined!).
TRAP 1: y = c₁ e^(x + c₂)
Rewrite: y = c₁ · e^(c₂) · e^x = C e^x where C = c₁ e^(c₂).
Only 1 ESSENTIAL CONSTANT ⟹ ORDER OF ODE IS 1 (NOT 2!)
TRAP 2: y = c₁ cos(x + c₂) + c₃ sin(x + c₄)
Expanding trig terms collapses to A cos x + B sin x (2 constants).
Only 2 ESSENTIAL CONSTANTS ⟹ ORDER OF ODE IS 2 (NOT 4!)
TRAP 3: y = (c₁ + c₂) e^x + c₃ e^(x + c₄)
All terms are multiples of e^x ⟹ y = [ (c₁+c₂) + c₃ e^(c₄) ] e^x = K e^x.
Only 1 ESSENTIAL CONSTANT ⟹ ORDER OF ODE IS 1 (NOT 4!)
B. GEOMETRIC FAMILIES & ORDER IDENTIFICATION
Count geometric degrees of freedom in the specified family of curves:
Circles with center on x-axis and touching y-axis:
(x - r)² + y² = r² ⟹ 1 arbitrary parameter (r) ⟹ ORDER = 1
Circles with fixed radius R and center in the xy-plane:
(x - h)² + (y - k)² = R² ⟹ 2 parameters (h, k) ⟹ ORDER = 2
All circles in the xy-plane (arbitrary center and arbitrary radius):
(x - h)² + (y - k)² = r² ⟹ 3 parameters (h, k, r) ⟹ ORDER = 3
All parabolas having axis parallel to x-axis:
(y - k)² = 4a(x - h) ⟹ 3 parameters (h, k, a) ⟹ ORDER = 3
All straight lines in the plane:
y = mx + c ⟹ 2 parameters (m, c) ⟹ ORDER = 2 (y'' = 0)
C. TITAN REVISION CHECKLIST (10-SEC RULES)
Rule 1: Order is ALWAYS an Integer ≥ 1
Never undefined. Highest derivative order is purely topological.
Rule 2: Degree is Undefined ONLY If Derivatives are Non-Polynomial
If x or y is in transcendental, degree is STILL DEFINED as long as derivatives are polynomials!
Rule 3: Non-Linearity Spreads Instantly
Even one non-linear term (e.g. y·y' or y²) makes the ENTIRE equation non-linear.
Rule 4: Invert Variables If dy/dx Is Inconvenient
If non-linear in y, check if linear in x: dx/dy + P(y)x = Q(y).
Rule 5: General Solution vs Particular Solution
General solution contains n constants; particular solution contains 0 constants.
